profile.headline: iOS Software Engineer
profile.summary: Product-focused iOS Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience working in startup and enterprise teams. I have launched over a dozen apps, including one featured on the App Store and two accepted into Techstars’ programs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Mobile Lead/Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led mobile development in an incubator, resulting in two Series A companies. I architected and launched:
• Shoebox: a sports trading card app that can identify and estimate the price of a card within seconds after scanning. Co-led the architecture of a system that’s able to accurately identify a card within 14 million cards and parses over 100 terabytes of sales data to estimate card prices. Technologies: SwiftUI, Combine, TCA.
• Here: an audio discovery app that allows users to share short audio clips of songs, podcasts, and voice recordings. Built a custom audio editing tool allowing the user to trim, move, and preview audio clips. Technologies: Swift, UIKit, Combine, TCA.
• Stakes: a sports wagering app that featured live Q&A betting during a sports game. Led the refactoring of code to move away from MVC to MVVM to drastically improve code maintainability. Technologies: Objective-C, Swift, UIKit, MVVM.
• A “Robinhood for music” app (in stealth mode) allowing users to trade shares of songs on a regulatory-compliant marketplace. Work included integrations with several vendors: a secure authentication and authorization platform, online identity verification, bank deposits and withdrawals, and Spotify/Apple Music integrations. Technologies: React Native, RTK Query.
• Initiated a mobile CI pipeline for all projects using GitHub Actions, Bitrise, and Fastlane to automate builds, reducing idle developer time.
positions.insights: Skills: Swift (Programming Language) · The Composable Architecture · iOS · SwiftUI

positions.title: iOS Director
positions.description:
Director of an iOS team and mobile lead on several app projects in a digital agency. My work included:
• Mentoring and coaching 8+ engineers, guiding them on iOS best practices and code quality.
• m360, an iPad app for AB InBev that allowed their wholesale department to track inventory and order management. Led the design and development to enable offline, all-day usage of an app used by traveling salespeople. Technologies: Swift, UIKit, RxSwift, and MVVM.
• Koala, an order-ahead iPhone and iPad app, for fast-casual restaurants. Team lead of white-label and fully customized implementations for clients such as Shake Shack and Deep Indian Kitchen. Technologies: Swift, UIKit, RxSwift, and MVVM.

positions.title: Co-founder
positions.description: Built an app that presented visual summaries of non-fiction books. Accepted into Techstars Boulder 2017. Technologies: Objective-C, UIKit, and MVC.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: Built General Assembly’s first mobile app that curates meetup events in your city relating to business, tech, and design. Technologies: Objective-C, UIKit, and MVC.

positions.title: Co-founder/Mobile Lead
positions.description: Built a video messaging app with a conversational, text message-style interface. Accepted into Techstars NYC 2014. Technologies: Objective-C, UIKit, AVFoundation, and MVC.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Worked on a learning management system for compliance training courses. Technologies: Java, Spring, and MVC.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description: Worked on several enterprise projects within the retail, telecommunications, utility, and banking industries. Technologies: Java, and Oracle SQL.
